text: Values shall be initialized before reading/publication. Plain and atomic stores may initialize; atomic loads, all RMW including `xchg`, and both compare/exchange outcomes shall require a complete old value. Failed compare/exchange shall initialize nothing; fences shall read no value.
clause_basis: Conservative sentence/semicolon seed groups; semantic clause review required before closure.
